summary: NXT Energy Solutions filed a Form 6-K furnishing an operational update press release dated October 14, 2026. The company reported completion of SFD flight operations in Africa within 14 days, mobilization for a new South Asia survey, and progress on its Canadian SFD growth initiative with Baycrest Energy as advisor. It exercised the early purchase option on its Cessna Citation 560 Ultra lease, attaining 100% unencumbered ownership of operating assets, and noted long-term debt of roughly $519,000 at 4% due May 2031, with no convertible debentures outstanding. Q3-26 results are due by November 16, 2026.
